note: _dicite pusillanimis: conformamini_ – say to the fainthearted: take courage! (Douay Version, Knox). The German Allioli version has “seid getrost,” which is somewhat weak; see the Tusculum Vulgata’s “Seid stark” (be strong), and Kaulen (p. 205): “sich ermannen.” – Note that the 1965 printing of the Colunga/Turrado edition of the Vulgate Bible (16.2) has a printing error: _dicit_ (instead of the correct _dicite_).
